editorial:
Imagine stepping into a world where training to be a security guard feels like going to a high-stakes boot camp. You get to follow Hani, a determined lead played by Liyana Yus, as she pushes herself to the limit to join an elite squad. The goal is simple but huge: protect one of Brunei's most precious natural treasures from people who want to steal it. It feels like a mix of a sports movie and an action flick, with a lighthearted vibe that keeps you smiling. You will love seeing the chemistry between the all-star Bruneian cast as they balance tough training with plenty of laughs.

What really works here is the pacing, as it never feels like it drags. The action scenes are snappy, and the comedy lands well without feeling forced. While some of the plot beats are a bit predictable, the energy of the performers makes up for it. If you are looking for a fun movie night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. Or, if you like owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to support local cinema.
endingExplained: In the final act, Hani must put all her training to the test during a high-stakes confrontation. She faces off against the villains trying to steal the treasure, using her new skills to outsmart them. After a series of exciting fights and close calls, Hani and her team successfully secure the treasure. The movie wraps up with Hani proving she has what it takes to be an elite guard, earning the respect of her peers and mentors.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted action and underdog stories.
